about_the_game:
About the Game
Are you ready to find over 1,000 mischievous cats across uniquely hand-drawn maps set in more than 10 countries? Explore peacefully alone or have fun together with a friend in online co-op mode. Once you find all the cats, color the black-and-white maps and create your own colorful world! 🐾🎨

Relaxing Drawing and Coloring
The game offers a relaxing and free-spirited coloring experience. You can follow guided, number-based coloring step-by-step or create your own pastel palette and draw freely. Soft pastel tones and smooth drawing style reduce stress while unleashing your creativity. ✏️🌈

Fun and Calm In-Game Radio
Complete the atmosphere with the in-game radio featuring specially curated lo-fi, chillhop, and calming music. Enjoy a peaceful experience with relaxing music and natural ambient sounds while exploring and coloring. Plus, surprise radio broadcasts await you! 🎧🎶

Explore Together in Online Co-op
Grab your friend and find and color cats together in online co-op mode! Share your color palettes, compete on leaderboards, and enjoy your shared achievements. Fun is better together! 🤝🐱
